choices.text: Stop and tell Ernesto the parts are out of tolerance before welding anything.
Build up the gap with extra weld passes and grind to fit.
Re-cut the parts yourself from stock; it costs an hour but keeps to the print.

response.text: At your fabrication shop in Manteca, you’re welding brackets for a dairy’s feed-handling frame. The saw-cut parts are 1/8 inch short, which the print doesn’t allow. The delivery truck leaves at 2:00.
response.title: Fit-up is off
